line.name: Sapphire
line.binder: Dual binder: one leaf from Esteli, Nicaragua and one from the Jamastran Valley, Honduras
line.filler: Nicaraguan (Condega, Esteli and Jalapa), aged 6-7 years
line.background_text: Sapphire is the third entry in Rocky Patel's unofficial 'precious metals and gems' series, following Gold Label and Emerald (both 2024). It debuted at the April 2026 PCA Convention & Trade Show in New Orleans before shipping to retailers as a retailer-exclusive release. Rocky Patel describes it as using older tobaccos than Emerald, making it richer and stronger, and it marks the first commercial use of leaf from his three-year-old Honduran farm; nearly all of the blend aside from the wrapper comes from Patel's own farms.
